title: Engaging!
text:
I am not a soccer fan, but my 14-year-old son convinced me to take this tour.
Nice, a great feeling to be able to walk (without guides who usually become intrusive) through the museum, stands, locker rooms, and playing field, wrapped in the red and white colors of the team. Great guy from security who, while watching the videos of the victories in Europe, had chills next to me. True passion
author: Stefanomarzuoli

title: Highly recommended
text: Nice experience. Staff friendly and helpful. Nice stadium to view.
author: judydH9051OO

title: Stadium Tour Sevilla FC
text:
We did the stadium tour while visiting the club shop and it was well worth doing for an hour or so. The tour is self guided and you walk around yourself with acces to the museum displaying their trophies and history along with access to the tunnels, changing room and pitchside dugouts. 

Family of four cost €40 for admission and it was a nice experience overall and not crowded so easy to wander around and enjoy. Nice option for something a little bit different when visiting Seville.
author: tp802016

title: A must for a football fan in Seville
text: An outstanding tour for the price the history of the club shown with old kits on show and some magnificent trophies. The access to the changing rooms and press room also included a brilliant stadium what felt like a proper stadium not like the new fake ones that are built.
author: Paul S

title: Really nicely done
text:
The only stadium tours I have done before have been guided tours of UK stadiums where you have to stick with a group. This self-guided, self-paced, tour was much better and works very well with a family group as we could spend our time where we chose to. 
The halls containing exhibits covering the history of the club and the trophy hall are excellent; beautifully laid out with plenty of explanatory signs in English as well as Spanish.

title: Nice and well organised
text: Sevilla's stadium is beautiful. You can reach it with bus 21 from the center and after less than 5 minutes you will emerge between the houses. Nice impact at first sight and the tour is absolutely worth doing due to how well it is organised. Tickets at the totem outside the entrance and you are ready to simply follow the route among memorabilia and curiosities until you find yourself on the sidelines for the usual photos.
author: Pier M

title: Funny to see
text:
The red color of floors, walls, seats and chairs made the experience more dramatic...
There were exhibited quite wild cups, which reminded of royalty - very beautiful.
The course itself and the spectator seats were worn...
It was fun to sit in the players’ seats at the pitch and imagine what it might be like.
The players' dressing room was closed, which was unfortunate because it great in the plan and it would have been interesting to see.
author: Yvonne Faxøe G

title: Great tour, not impressed by the staff
text:
Self-guided audio tour.  

Positives
Halls were interesting.  Press room and pitch were really impressive.  

Negatives
No information provided prior to the tour about the need to download the tour app to access the audio tour.  Staff seemed confused about the app and how to access audio.  Figured it out using google.  Interactive features like getting a picture taken were not in service.  Staff seemed uninterested and it felt like they couldn’t wait for us to leave.

Still, an interesting tour.  Exciting to go on the pitch.  Good value for the money.
author: Ednorton99
